$comment: Per-fixture facts the fixture tree cannot state. Everything else in the catalog is derived from disk: a directory with an input file is a fixture, output.json makes it a conformance fixture, output.tsgo.json makes that a reviewed TypeScript 7 divergence, ts7-oracle.json is the divergence record, and warnings.tsgo.json supplies the warning oracle and its code order.

timing.$comment: IPC ceilings for the boundary plan, in plan order. The conformance plan measures the same four fixtures in the same order.
timing.bytesReceivedReason: TypeScript 7.1's API protocol, which tsrs ports, sends every symbol as a SymbolReference that repeats its owner's full source-file descriptor (file name, path, content hash) and returns each project's absolute file names twice (parsedCommandLine.fileNames and rootFiles), where TypeScript 7.0.2 sent a bare symbol id. Bytes therefore grew and scale with the checkout path; request counts and every other counter are unchanged, so the walk is no denser. Each maxBytesReceived is at or above the tsrs measurement from a 130-character workspace root, and each bytesReceivedPathLengthHeadroom covers at least 64 more path characters at the measured bytes per character.

expectedTypecheckDiagnostics.reason: TypeScript 7.1 reports TS7031 for a property destructured without a default from a parameter whose default is `{}`; TypeScript 7.0.2 inferred it silently, and typescript@7.1.0-beta reports the same two diagnostics. input.tsx is immutable evidence, so the gate requires exactly these diagnostics and fails on any other.
